title: Canvas Window Spacing Uniformity
description: Fix vertical spacing between left and right canvas windows to match horizontal spacing and canvas edge insets.
summary: Unified all shell chrome gutters to --spacing-single so navbar padding, button-group gaps, canvas edge insets, inter-window splitters, side-panel offsets, and toolbar group gaps share one unit. Canvas/Mode/HorizontalWindows/VerticalWindows, ResizableHandle, Panel, and SidePanel now use single; touch toolbar tokens aligned.
